nodes.name: Costruisci digest

parameters.query: -- Tutto l'HTML si compone in SQL: nessun Code node, e la logica sta -- dove stanno i dati. Filtro fornitore_persona_fisica = 0 come da R3. WITH lead AS ( SELECT * FROM radar.v_lead_90gg WHERE fornitore_persona_fisica = 0 ), per_categoria AS ( SELECT string_agg( '' || coalesce(categoria, 'Non classificato') || '' || cnt || '€ ' || coalesce(replace(to_char(val, 'FM999G999G999'), ',', '.'), 'n.d.') || '', '' ORDER BY val DESC NULLS LAST) AS html FROM (SELECT categoria, count(*) AS cnt, sum(importo_aggiudicazione) AS val FROM lead GROUP BY categoria) t ), prime25 AS ( SELECT string_agg( '' || gg || '' || ente || '' || prov || '' || cat || '€ ' || imp || '' || forn || '' || pec || '', '' ORDER BY ord DESC NULLS LAST) AS html FROM (SELECT giorni_alla_scadenza AS gg, left(coalesce(ente, '?'), 46) AS ente, coalesce(provincia, '') AS prov, coalesce(categoria, 'n.c.') AS cat, coalesce(replace(to_char(importo_aggiudicazione, 'FM999G999G999'), ',', '.'), 'n.d.') AS imp, left(coalesce(fornitore_uscente, ''), 30) AS forn, pec, importo_aggiudicazione AS ord FROM lead ORDER BY importo_aggiudicazione DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 25) t ) SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM lead) AS tot, to_char(now(), 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS oggi, per_categoria.html AS html_categorie, prime25.html AS html_prime25 FROM per_categoria, prime25;
